// tests/zoneinfo_vectors_tests.nv — both packs against Python's
// `zoneinfo`, over twenty zones and their transitions.
//
// Generated by tools/zoneinfo_vectors.py.  Do not edit the two tables:
// run the tool.  `zoneinfo` reads the system's TZif files, compiled from
// the same tzdata release as the packs, and its answers are written in
// here so the suite needs no Python when it runs.
//
// The zones are the ones with a case that breaks implementations: a
// thirty-minute saving (Lord Howe), a skipped day (Apia), southern rules
// that wrap the year (Sydney, Santiago, Sao Paulo), offsets of a quarter
// or a half hour (Chatham, Kolkata, Tehran, St Johns), a rule that
// moves every year with Ramadan (Casablanca), a change time past
// midnight (Nuuk, Scoresbysund), a two-hour saving (Troll), a
// fourteen-hour offset (Kiritimati), and ordinary European and American
// rules.

use std.test
use std.str
use std.list
use tzdata
use tzlocal
use tzzone
